sloka: ताम् अकामाम् स काम आर्तः पन्नग इन्द्र वधूम् इव ।विवेष्टमानाम् आदाय उत्पपात अथ रावणः ॥३-४९-२२॥
transliteration: tām akāmām sa kāma ārtaḥ pannaga indra vadhūm iva ।viveṣṭamānām ādāya utpapāta atha rāvaṇaḥ ॥3-49-22॥

translations.english: Passionate Ravana took hold of Sita who was not willing and was writhing in pain. He seized her like (an eagle carrying away) a serpent queen and flew up.
